metadata.title: The Merger Leak
metadata.subtitle: A $400M merger leaked with MY watermark—and the only person with my laptop password is my fiancé at the rival bank.

nodes.text: 08:05 AM · Breaking news flashes on every trading screen. Your $400M merger leaked overnight—stock plunges 22%.
Jordan, your badge is frozen. The leaked PDF sent to the press carries YOUR invisible digital watermark—downloaded at 2:14 AM from your home IP.
2:14 AM?! I was dead asleep! The only other person in my apartment last night was... Ethan.
Boss, our short-sell trade just cleared $8M! Don’t worry—the watermark points straight to Jordan, not me.
Babe, just saw the stock crash!! Are you okay?! If compliance asks, tell them your laptop must have been hacked!

nodes.transcript: [ice cold] Jordan, federal regulators arrive at 10 AM. Unless you prove someone else touched your laptop at 2:14 AM, you are facing insider-trading charges.

nodes.prompt: You have 90 minutes before prison becomes real. What do you pull?

options.label: Pull home router logs & USB transfer history
options.player_reply_text: Elena, check my laptop’s USB device serial log from 2:14 AM—it wasn’t sent by email!

options.label: Pull your smartwatch sleep data + ring cam
options.player_reply_text: My smartwatch logged deep REM sleep from 11 PM to 6 AM—and my bedroom smart-cam covers the desk!

nodes.text: Wait... the file was copied to an encrypted USB registered to Apex Rival Bank—Ethan’s employer!
HD CLIP CAPTURED: At 2:13 AM, Ethan is caught on your living-room camera typing your password, copying the merger PDF, and smiling!
Oh my god... Ethan used his own fiancée as a human shield for an $8M short-sell!
I’m coming over to your office lobby right now to support you, babe. Don’t say a word to compliance until I get there!

nodes.headline: He’s Walking Into the Trap
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 2: Ethan walks into the Emergency Board Hearing pretending to be your loving fiancé—right in front of federal agents.

nodes.text: 10:00 AM · Boardroom A. Chairman Park, Compliance, and two SEC investigators sit across from you and Ethan.
Chairman Park, Jordan has been under huge stress. Maybe they accidentally emailed the draft while half-asleep—please go easy on them.
How sweet of you to throw me under the bus, Ethan. Tell the investigators what you were doing on my laptop at 2:13 AM.
Delete the Apex trade logs NOW!! Jordan knows about the USB!!

nodes.transcript: [firm] Too late, Ethan. The SEC just subpoenaed Apex Rival Bank—and matched the USB serial number directly to your corporate badge.

nodes.prompt: Ethan jumps up, knocking his chair back. Deliver the final blow.

options.label: Slide the engagement ring across the table
options.player_reply_text: Take your ring back, Ethan. You can’t wear jewelry in federal prison anyway.

options.label: Play the 2:13 AM living-room video for SEC
options.player_reply_text: Gentlemen, watch him smile at my camera while stealing a $400M merger file.

nodes.text: The two federal investigators step behind Ethan and read him his rights as the boardroom watches in silence.
MERGER SAVED: Regulators halt the illegal short-sell, recover the stock price, and indict both Ethan and his Managing Director!
Your badge is restored with full Partner clearance, Jordan. Thank you for saving this firm.
Let’s close that $400 million merger before lunch, Chairman.

nodes.headline: Deal Closed, Traitor Cuffed
nodes.teaser_text: As Ethan is led past the glass doors, he mouths one chilling sentence to you: "You think I was the only one at your company helping Apex?"

nodes.text: 4:40 PM · Executive Compliance Suite. Ethan is in federal custody—yet his chilling parting words prove true.
Jordan! Ethan wasn’t bluffing! Ten minutes AFTER he was cuffed, someone inside our tower exported the updated $400M merger valuation sheet!
Only four people on the 50th floor have clearance for that valuation sheet… who accessed it?!

nodes.caption: RECOVERED FROM ETHAN’S COAT · Apex Bank VIP Suite Keycard — Co-registered to "VP Finance, Tower 50".

nodes.text: Hold the signing dinner! If Apex Bank has our final counter-offer before 7 PM, they’ll undercut us by $50 million!
Tell Jordan the second mole sits right across from Chairman Park at—

nodes.transcript: [whispering] Jordan, I cross-checked the Apex hotel keycard timestamp against our building badge logs—only ONE executive left Floor 50 during that exact hour: VP Victor Han!

nodes.prompt: The signing dinner with Chairman Park starts in 90 minutes! How do you trap the second mole?

options.label: Plant a fake $435M canary price in the deck
options.player_reply_text: Chairman Park, upload a decoy valuation of $435M ONLY to the VP’s shared folder—if Apex bids $436M at dinner, we catch him cold!

options.label: Plant canary price + trace his burner GPS
options.player_reply_text: Plant the $435M decoy AND have Elena’s compliance team flag any burner phone pinging the hotel Wi-Fi near the dinner club!

nodes.text: CANARY TRAP SET: Chairman Park smiles grimly—"Brilliant, Jordan. Let’s see how fast he takes the bait."
FULL SURVEILLANCE: Within twelve minutes, the VP downloads the decoy file—and an unregistered burner pings from the restroom!
You just saved a $400M deal twice in one day, Jordan. Meet me at the Private Club at 6:30 PM sharp.
My lawyer let me send one message: Victor recruited me three months ago. Don’t let him walk away while I take the fall.

nodes.headline: The Signing Dinner Trap
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 4: Step into the private club where the second mole is already texting Apex Bank.

nodes.text: 6:40 PM · Private Executive Club. Crystal glasses chime while Apex’s envoy smirks across the mahogany table.
Unbelievable—Apex’s envoy just slid over a surprise rival bid of EXACTLY $436 million! The canary trap worked!
Which means our VP leaked the $435M decoy file straight to Apex within the last hour.
GOT HIM! The burner phone just transmitted the decoy PDF from the club terrace—and he tried to smash the SIM tray when he saw me walk out!
Tell the federal prosecutor I’ll testify against Victor if they reduce—
Apex’s envoy is sweating bullets—he thinks our real bid is $435M when our actual board-approved cap is $400M!

nodes.transcript: [security footsteps] Club security just recovered the cracked burner phone from the planter box—and the GPS log links it straight to the Apex hotel suite AND tonight’s terrace!

nodes.prompt: You hold the cracked burner phone and caught Apex red-handed! How do you close the merger?

options.label: Expose the espionage & disqualify Apex
options.player_reply_text: Chairman Park, place the burner phone and hotel keycard on the table—disqualify Apex’s tainted bid right now!

options.label: Disqualify Apex + lock a $15M discount
options.player_reply_text: Expose Apex’s corporate espionage to the seller—and offer an immediate all-cash close tonight at $385M!

nodes.text: TARGET BOARD STUNNED: The seller’s chairman immediately disqualifies Apex and signs exclusively with Chairman Park at $395M!
DEAL OF THE DECADE: The seller signs on the spot to avoid regulatory fallout—saving Chairman Park $15 MILLION!
Federal agents just arrived at the club entrance for our former VP. That was surgical, Jordan.
Uploading the cracked burner GPS forensic report to the SEC right now!

nodes.headline: The Burner At The Club
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 5: Lock in the forensic GPS proof and watch both traitors face federal justice.

nodes.text: 8:15 PM · Tower 50th Floor. The ink on the $400M merger agreement is finally dry.
Forensics extracted the complete GPS and call log from the cracked burner—every secret meeting between Victor, Ethan, and Apex is mapped to the minute.

nodes.caption: BURNER FORENSICS · Cracked phone GPS matched to Apex VIP Suite (Mon) & Private Club Terrace (18:41).

nodes.text: My attorney says testifying against Victor might keep me out of maximum security… Jordan, I never stopped loving you. I just got greedy.
You stole my laptop password while I was asleep and put MY watermark on a felony leak, Ethan. That isn’t love—it’s betrayal.
I’ll spend the next five years regretting the night I opened her laptop—

nodes.transcript: [champagne pouring] Jordan, the Board just held a five-minute vote: the VP of Finance & M&A seat is vacant—and it’s YOURS if you want it!

nodes.prompt: Chairman Park offers you the vacant VP seat on the 50th floor! How do you accept?

options.label: Accept VP & tighten deal-room security
options.player_reply_text: I accept, Chairman—and my first priority is rebuilding our deal-room security with Elena so no leak ever happens again.

options.label: Accept VP + 1% merger closing bonus
options.player_reply_text: I’ll take the VP chair, rebuild security with Elena—and I’d love the standard 1% deal-saver bonus on the money we just saved!

nodes.text: NEW LEADERSHIP: Chairman Park raises his glass—"To the sharpest dealmaker on the 50th floor!"
CHAIRMAN LAUGHS: "You negotiate like a Managing Director already! Approved—bonus AND Managing Director fast-track!"
From framed suspect at 9 AM to VP of M&A by 8 PM. Put that in a business school textbook!
And I’m changing my laptop password to 24 random characters—and keeping my engagement ring finger gloriously free.

nodes.headline: Signed And Sealed
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 6 (Finale): Ring the merger closing bell beside Chairman Park and step into your powerhouse future.

nodes.text: One Week Later · Financial Exchange Bell Podium. Cameras flash as the $400M merger officially closes.
Two minutes to the opening bell, VP Jordan. Markets already jumped 11% on our merger closing!
Best feeling in the world seeing our combined logo up on the exchange ticker.
Update from DOJ: Apex Bank just paid a $25M regulatory fine for corporate espionage, and both Victor and Ethan pleaded guilty.
Watching her ring the exchange bell on the news—I lost everything—

nodes.transcript: [bell ringing loudly & crowd cheering] DEAL CLOSED! Stand front and center for the cameras, Jordan—you earned every flashbulb!

nodes.text: Calling Elena up onto the podium too—we’re a team.

nodes.prompt: A financial anchor asks for your #1 lesson from closing the $400M merger:

options.label: Trust is earned; verify every watermark
options.player_reply_text: Protect your integrity, verify every trail, and never let anyone watermark your name onto their lies.

options.label: Dedicate your bonus to a Women in M&A fund
options.player_reply_text: And I’m putting part of my closing bonus into a fellowship mentoring young women breaking into M&A and compliance!

nodes.text: HEADLINE QUOTE: Your interview clips trend across financial media before noon.
FINANCIAL ICON: Chairman Park matches your contribution dollar for dollar—cementing your legacy on the 50th floor.
Deal closed, traitors cuffed, future unstoppable. Drinks tonight, VP!
Welcome to the top of the tower, Jordan.

nodes.headline: FINALE · Queen Of The Deal Room
nodes.teaser_text: You cleared your watermark, unmasked both moles, and closed the $400M merger on your own terms.
